subtext.hi: Triangles similar prove karne ke 4 main criteria — har exam mein aate hain!
subtext.en: 4 main criteria to prove triangles are similar — they appear in every exam!

text.hi: In char criteria mein se koi bhi ek satisfy hone par triangles similar maane jaate hain.
text.en: If any one of these four criteria is satisfied, the triangles are considered similar.

content.hi: AAA (Angle-Angle-Angle): teen corresponding angles equal. AA: do corresponding angles equal (third automatically equal).
content.en: AAA (Angle-Angle-Angle): three corresponding angles equal. AA: two corresponding angles equal (third is automatically equal).

content.hi: SSS (Side-Side-Side): teen corresponding sides same ratio mein. SAS (Side-Angle-Side): do sides same ratio + included angle equal.
content.en: SSS (Side-Side-Side): three corresponding sides in the same ratio. SAS (Side-Angle-Side): two sides in the same ratio + included angle equal.

content.hi: Triangle ke teeno angles ka sum hamesha 180° hota hai. Agar do angles equal hain, third automatically equal ho jaata hai — isliye AA hi kaafi hai.
content.en: The three angles of a triangle always sum to 180°. If two angles are equal, the third is automatically equal too — so AA alone is enough.

explanation.content: AAA: ∠A=∠P,∠B=∠Q,∠C=∠R | AA: any 2 angles equal | SSS: AB/PQ=BC/QR=CA/RP | SAS: AB/PQ=BC/QR, ∠B=∠Q (included angle)

problem.hi: ΔABC, ΔPQR mein ∠A=50°,∠B=60° aur ∠P=50°,∠Q=60°. Prove karo ΔABC ~ ΔPQR.
problem.en: In ΔABC and ΔPQR, ∠A=50°,∠B=60° and ∠P=50°,∠Q=60°. Prove ΔABC ~ ΔPQR.

problem.hi: ΔABC ke sides AB=6,BC=8,CA=10cm. ΔPQR ke sides PQ=3,QR=4,RP=5cm. Dikhao ΔABC~ΔPQR.
problem.en: ΔABC sides AB=6,BC=8,CA=10cm. ΔPQR sides PQ=3,QR=4,RP=5cm. Show ΔABC~ΔPQR.

problem.hi: ΔABC: AB=8,BC=10,∠B=40°. ΔPQR: PQ=4,QR=5,∠Q=40°. Dikhao similar hain.
problem.en: ΔABC: AB=8,BC=10,∠B=40°. ΔPQR: PQ=4,QR=5,∠Q=40°. Show they're similar.

question.hi: ∠A=∠P aur ∠B=∠Q ho, to ΔABC~ΔPQR kis se?

explanation.hi: Do angles equal se AA similarity.
explanation.en: Two angles equal gives AA similarity.

question.hi: AB/PQ=BC/QR=CA/RP=3/2 ho, to kis se similar?

explanation.hi: Teeno sides same ratio mein — SSS similarity.
explanation.en: All three sides in the same ratio — SSS similarity.

question.hi: SAS similarity mein angle kaunsa hona chahiye?
question.en: In SAS similarity, the angle must be:

explanation.hi: Do proportional sides ke beech ka angle equal hona chahiye.
explanation.en: The angle between the two proportional sides must be equal.

question.hi: Do triangles ke do angles equal hain to teesra bhi equal hoga.
question.en: If two angles of one triangle equal two angles of another, the third angles are also equal.

explanation.hi: Angle sum property se third angle automatically equal ho jaata hai.
explanation.en: By the angle sum property, the third angle is automatically equal too.

question.hi: Board exams mein sabse common criterion kaunsa hai?
question.en: Which criterion is most commonly used in board exams?

explanation.hi: AA sabse simple hai — sirf do angles check karne hain.
explanation.en: AA is simplest — only two angles need checking.

notes.hi: SAS: do sides proportional + included angle equal
notes.en: SAS: two sides proportional + included angle equal

summary.hi: 4 criteria yaad rakho — AA sabse zyada exams mein use hota hai kyunki sirf do angles check karne padte hain.
summary.en: Remember the 4 criteria — AA is used most in exams since only two angles need checking.
